opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to buy stakes in a mining pool for as little as $500, stating that participants will receive payouts according to their share over the next 1,000 days. It then turns that investment pitch into an enrollment instruction: “Register with the BITCLUB now by clicking on the link below following the instructions to activate your account.” The claimed upside is reinforced by a scenario involving “the doubling of my investment over the first thousand days in the worst cases,” alongside assertions that BitClub mined more than fifty thousand bitcoins for members and that its information turned partners into millionaires. A BitClub “Register now” button and mining imagery support the solicitation, while no independently verified returns or outcomes are provided.

citations.quote: Only the Bit Club lets you purchase stakes in the world's largest mining pool, at as little as 500 dollars.
You will then participate in the payout according to your share for the next 1,000 days.
Register with the BITCLUB now by clicking on the link below following the instructions to activate your account
